butterfly.path: x(t)=x0+Ax*sin(w1*t+p), y(t)=y0+Ay*sin(w2*t+q), z(t)=0.7+0.25*sin(w3*t); A~0.8-1.6 units, w~0.3-0.7 rad/s
butterfly.placement: sprite.position = terrainProject(x, y, z); sprite.anchor = frame anchor (body centre); scale = assetScale
butterfly.budget: <= 6 visible; only near flower beds/blossom trees in daylight
butterfly.reducedMotion: do not spawn (or show one resting sprite on a flower bed, frame 3, no path motion)
butterfly.depth: draw above all objects in the same tile band (x+y+0.5) - purely decorative, never occludes UI

firefly.placement: sprite.position = terrainProject(x, y, z); anchor (0.5,0.5); scale = assetScale * 2
firefly.budget: <= 24 visible; evening/night presentation only; skip when zoomed below 0.45
firefly.reducedMotion: static glows at fixed positions with constant alpha 0.6, no wander or pulse
firefly.depth: a single top layer above objects (additive light, no sorting needed)

cv-artlab-batch-c-effects-01.provenance: Original art-lab butterfly geometry; procedural firefly glow. No third-party assets.

lanternGlow.budget: one per lantern emitter, culled off-screen
lanternGlow.layer: top light layer (above objects, below UI)

chimneySmoke.spawn: one puff every 1.6-2.4 s per chimney emitter (deterministic phase from building id)
chimneySmoke.motion: rise 0.35 units/s, drift +0.12 units/s along logical (+x,-y) wind, scale 0.6->1.6, alpha 0.55->0 over 3.5 s
chimneySmoke.budget: <= 3 live puffs per chimney; skip below zoom 0.45

leaves.spawn: near tree placements (petal-0 only near blossom trees), 1 per ~4 s per tree, max 12 on screen
leaves.motion: fall 0.25 units/s from canopy height with sin sway (amp 0.3, 0.8 rad/s) and spin 1.5 rad/s; fade on landing

dustMotes.motion: slow wander like fireflies, alpha 0.15-0.35, daylight only in sunbeam areas

effects.butterflies: unchanged: cv-artlab-batch-c-effects-01 (flap frames + runtime path); budget <= 6 in daylight
effects.fireflies: unchanged: cv-artlab-batch-c-effects-01 (glow + runtime wander/pulse); budget <= 24 at evening

global.zoomGate: all ambient effects off below zoom 0.45 except lantern glow
global.drawCalls: all ambient sprites share one atlas page with the effects-01 page => 1-2 batches
global.gameplay: purely decorative; never block picking, never imply real users or presence

emitters.rule: terrainProject(px + ex, py + ey, h + ez) where (px, py, h) is the asset placement
